summary: The E-MTAB-15488 deposit contains sample counts for both mouse cohorts. The public sources reviewed yielded no gene-level author result for either hypothalamus contrast. Author concordance remains untested.

manualReview.summary: No public author gene-level result located for either registered hypothalamus contrast
manualReview.note: The deposit lists an IDF, an SDRF and one processed file, raw_counts.tsv. All 86 measurement columns match SDRF sample names. The IDF describes right-hemisphere microdissection and DESeq2 normalization. The matrix contains counts for 21 of 23 hypothalamus samples. D09Hy (water control) and Op57Hy (floxed control) have ENA runs but no count columns. NCBI ELink returned zero direct GEO DataSets links for the 23 BioSamples. The BioProject request without a destination searched PubMed, and an explicit SRA request returned 94 sequencing records across tissues. Searches by accession, sample alias, investigator and design located no public author effects for these libraries. Bao et al. sequenced distal colon and small intestinal organoids. The SEPIA chronic-DSS study sequenced colon. The search log and independent spot-checks document the public review on 2026-11-22.
reviewFlags: Author effects, the author-tested gene universe, raw P values and FDR remain unassessed for dss_vs_control and opa1_vs_flox.

verificationReview.reason: The processed deposit contains sample counts. Across the reviewed archives, publications, preprints and data repositories, no author table or figure supplied gene-level results for either registered right-hemisphere hypothalamus contrast. The available edgeR log2 fold changes, P values and FDR values come from HypoExplorer’s reanalysis.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen either contrast if the authors identify a gene-level table or figure for these hypothalamus samples. Confirm its sample membership and case direction before comparing the reported effects and available statistics.
